newsitem.title: USA: Homestake, GeoBiotics in biotech pact.
newsitem.headline: Homestake, GeoBiotics in biotech pact.

text.p: Homestake Mining Co said late Thursday that it has entered a strategic alliance with a privately-owned technology development firm called GeoBiotics Inc, which has laboratories in San Francisco.

Homestake said it will make an equity investment in GeoBiotics, which will in turn grant Homestake a license to use GeoBiotics' technology at the Agua de la Falda gold mine in Chile, which Homestake owns with Codelco, the Chilean state copper company, or at another Homestake mine.

"Alliances with innovative technology companies like GeoBiotics are an important and efficient way for Homestake to participate in the development of new technologies for its mines," company Chief Executive Jack Thompson said in a release.
Terms of the pact were not disclosed, and the company could not be immediately reached for comment.

Homestake said GeoBiotics has developed proprietary bio-oxidation technology to recover mineral resources that is competitive with other methods and at lower costs. It said GeoBiotics currently is conducting large-scale testing of its technology and plans to commission its first commercial-scale plant before the end of 1997.
